home.documentDescription: KrishiLens is your AI-powered crop investigation assistant.
home.eyebrow: A new way to care for your crops
home.headline: Smarter Crop Care,
home.subtitle: Your AI-powered crop investigation assistant.
home.illustration: Illustration of healthy green crops growing in a field
home.builtFor: Built for the people who grow our food
home.intro: Share your observations to get cautious, AI-generated guidance. No image is analyzed, and this is not a confirmed diagnosis.
home.example: For example: Brown spots have appeared on my rice leaves

imageAnalysis.title: Segment a crop image
imageAnalysis.intro: Upload or capture a crop image. SAM 3.1 will separately look for the crop leaf and the selected visual region. Candidate discoloration is not necessarily crop damage or disease.
imageAnalysis.fileRules: JPEG, PNG, or WebP · Up to 5 MB · Single image only
imageAnalysis.noPercent: No percentage is shown because the masks were absent or could not be validated.
imageAnalysis.warning: The segmentation service returned an observation that needs attention.
imageAnalysis.caution: Segmentation highlights visual regions only. It does not diagnose a disease or establish scientifically validated crop severity. Confirm observations with a qualified agricultural officer.
imageAnalysis.describeInstead: Want to describe what you’ve seen instead?

investigation.title: Investigate your observations
investigation.intro: The agent uses actual scan observations and retrieved references, asks a follow-up when useful, and makes uncertainty clear.
investigation.askTitle: What would you like to investigate?
investigation.moreInfo: A little more information is needed
investigation.disclaimer: This is an investigation aid, not a confirmed diagnosis.
investigation.translateFailed: The report could not be translated. The original report is still available.
investigation.translationNote: Translated text is provided for readability. Original observations, measurements, and citations are unchanged.
investigation.noReportTranslation: Only report text is translated; the original follow-up question remains in {{language}}.
investigation.sessionLanguageNote: The investigation continues in its original language ({{language}}); this display translation does not change the case language.

questions.answerPlaceholder: Share what you have observed or know

questions.required: Please enter your observations or answer.

reports.title: Investigation report
reports.subtitle: Your crop investigation
reports.noCauses: Available information does not reliably distinguish possible causes.
reports.measurementAccepted: The segmented candidate region overlaps {{percentage}}% of the leaf mask. This is not disease severity.
reports.measurementMissing: No affected-area estimate is available; this is not interpreted as zero damage.
reports.noSources: No symptom-specific agricultural source was retrieved for this investigation.
reports.escalation: Consult a qualified local agricultural officer: {{reason}}
